summary: Official Uruapan municipal/IMPLAN pages and Michoacan institutional sources evidence local cadastral/planning custody, while SEDATU viewer inspection exposed national OGC routes. No anonymous bounded parcel ID plus geometry response was verified, so runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Spanish discovery queries and actual result URLs are recorded in city-3882-uruapan.json. The first-party results distinguish Uruapan municipal predial/cadastral custody, IMPLAN GIS/planning inventory, Michoacan state Catastro, and SEDATU/RAN national geospatial infrastructure.
requestOutcomes: Municipal and IMPLAN landing pages returned HTTP 200. The current SEDATU viewer returned HTTP 200 and its JavaScript exposed SEDATU GeoServer and RAN WMS/WFS routes, but the SEDATU GeoServer capabilities request timed out and no bounded feature query reached a usable parcel layer. No credentials, private tokens, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS disablement, formal submission, or unsafe lookup was used.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [19.410676635401, -102.047099594884] and latitude/longitude order were preserved; no coordinate shift or exact-point hit/miss inference was made.
The IMPLAN directory's cadastral zoning and RAN parcelled-property entries are catalogue/planning evidence, not proof that a public parcel API is available.
No parcel geometry, stable native identity, source field mapping, CRS, bounded response count, or citywide open coverage was verified.
A timeout, 404 on a guessed route, unavailable capability response, map extent miss, or unusable UI is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is research evidence only and is not source integration or adapter admission; serial reviewer qualification remains pending.
